scripts.ios: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Turna.xcworkspace -scheme Turna -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' build
scripts.ios:release: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Turna.xcworkspace -scheme Turna -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination generic/platform=iOS archive -archivePath $PWD/build/Turna.xcarchive
scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ios
